ei.title: 도시 교통 정책에서 드러나는 지속 가능성의 역설과 모순

fullPassage: The paradox of sustainability emerges strongly in urban transport. Governments that espouse environmental sustainability also espouse transport policies that deplete and ruin the environment. All too often in policy documents where environmental sustainability is discussed the urgent necessity of social and economic change is glossed over in language designed to reassure the reader that the right trade-off can be found between economic, social and environmental policies. With this magic mixture all will indeed be for the best in this world, the best of all possible worlds. Such policies deserve the term 'greenwash'. Whereas it is possible to trade off environmental and health benefits against economic growth (for that is what has always been done), it is logically impossible to trade off environmentally unsustainable growth against environmental sustainability. Growth is either environmentally sustainable or it's not.

questions.stem:
주어진 문장들을 글의 흐름에 맞게 배열한 것은?

(A) Such policies deserve the term 'greenwash'.
(B) The paradox of sustainability emerges strongly in urban transport.
(C) Governments that espouse environmental sustainability also espouse transport policies that deplete and ruin the environment.

det.korean: B(역설 도입) → C(모순 설명) → A(그린워시 비판).
det.analysis:
✅ ② (B)-(C)-(A): (B) 역설 도입 → (C) 정부의 모순적 정책 → (A) 그린워시라는 용어 비판.
❌ ① (A)-(B)-(C): 비판이 먼저 나오면 맥락 없음.
❌ ③ (C)-(B)-(A): 모순이 역설 도입보다 먼저.
❌ ④ (B)-(A)-(C): 그린워시가 모순 설명 전에 나옴.
det.tip: 도입(역설) → 설명(모순) → 비판(그린워시).

questions.stem:
주어진 문장들을 글의 흐름에 맞게 배열한 것은?

(A) Growth is either environmentally sustainable or it's not.
(B) Whereas it is possible to trade off environmental and health benefits against economic growth, it is logically impossible to trade off environmentally unsustainable growth against environmental sustainability.
(C) Such policies deserve the term 'greenwash'.
(D) With this magic mixture all will indeed be for the best in this world, the best of all possible worlds.

det.korean: D(마법의 혼합) → C(그린워시) → B(논리적 불가능) → A(결론).
det.analysis:
✅ ④ (D)-(C)-(B)-(A): (D) 마법의 혼합으로 최선 → (C) 그린워시 비판 → (B) 논리적으로 불가능한 교환 → (A) 이분법적 결론.
❌ ① (A)-(B)-(C)-(D): 결론이 먼저.
❌ ② (C)-(D)-(B)-(A): 그린워시가 혼합보다 먼저.
❌ ③ (D)-(B)-(C)-(A): 논리 논증이 그린워시보다 먼저는 어색.
det.tip: 비꼼(magic mixture) → 비판(greenwash) → 논증(impossible) → 결론.

questions.passage: The paradox of sustainability emerges strongly in urban transport. Governments that espouse environmental sustainability also espouse transport policies that deplete and ruin the environment. All too often in policy documents where environmental sustainability is discussed the urgent necessity of social and economic change is glossed over in language designed to reassure the reader that the right trade-off can be found between economic, social and environmental policies. With this magic mixture all will indeed be for the best in this world, the best of all possible worlds. Such policies deserve the term 'greenwash'. Whereas it is possible to trade off environmental and health benefits against economic growth (for that is what has always been done), it is logically impossible to trade off environmentally unsustainable growth against environmental sustainability. Growth is either environmentally sustainable or it's not.
questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: 정책 문서는 변화의 필요성을 솔직히 인정한다 — 불일치.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 지속 가능성의 역설은 도시 교통에서 강하게 나타난다: 일치.
❌ ② 정부는 환경 지속 가능성을 주장하면서도 환경 파괴 정책을 지지한다: 일치.
✅ ③ 정책 문서는 사회적, 경제적 변화의 필요성을 솔직히 인정한다: glossed over. 불일치.
❌ ④ 이러한 정책은 '그린워시'라는 용어를 받을 만하다: 일치.
det.tip: glossed over = 대충 넘기다 ≠ 솔직히 인정하다.

ch: 지속 가능성의 역설은 도시 교통에서 강하게 나타난다.

questions.passage: The paradox of sustainability emerges strongly in urban transport, revealing the __________ (necessary) of social and economic change.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (   ) 쓰시오. (1단어 (영어로))

det.analysis: 빈칸 앞에 관사 the가 있고 뒤에 전치사 of가 이어지므로 명사가 필요. necessary(형용사) → necessity(명사).
det.tip: necessary(필요한) → necessity(필요성).

questions.passage: It is __________ (logic) impossible to trade off unsustainable growth against environmental sustainability.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (   ) 쓰시오. (1단어 (영어로))

det.analysis: 빈칸 뒤에 형용사 impossible이 있으므로 부사가 필요. logic(명사) → logically(부사). logically impossible = 논리적으로 불가능한.
det.tip: logic(논리) → logical(논리적인) → logically(논리적으로).
